description: FamilySearch tree person read for Jean Baptiste Moreau WITH relatives and source descriptions. Regression fixture for issue #1901: the top-level `sources` array carries 6 attached source descriptions, but NOT ONE fact on ANY person carries a fact-level `sources` ref — mirroring the real-world FamilySearch pattern of sources attached at the person level without being linked to a specific claim. This is the exact shape that caused a live agent to report 'zero sources' for a person who had 52 attached: it conflated the (correctly empty) fact-level sources with the top-level array.
